item.title: ChatGPT Search Reaches 20% of Google Queries Daily
item.description: OpenAI says ChatGPT’s web‑search feature now handles 20 % of the queries Google processes, a milestone that reshapes AI‑driven search dynamics.

item.title: Google Lets Schools Turn Off AI, But Search Goes Dark
item.description: Google will default‑disable Gemini, Notebook LM and Gemini in Classroom for K‑12, forcing admins to enable AI or lose access to AI‑enhanced Search.
